2607.20692.title: DS@GT ARC at ImageCLEFmed GANs 2026: Geometric Filtering for Privacy-Preserving CT Slice Generation
2607.20692.paper_summary: We present a privacy-preserving framework for synthetic lung CT slice generation developed for the Image-CLEFmed GANs 2026 challenge. The approach combines Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching with privacy-oriented training and a post-generation "Supervisor" pipeline that filters generated candidates in learned geometric latent spaces using autoencoder embeddings, Determinantal Point Processes, and Stein Kernel Thinning. Official results show a strong realism-privacy trade-off, with the best-performing model achieving a Privacy Preservation Score of 0.549 and competitive visual fidelity with an FID of 0.3290. While the proposed geometric filtering substantially reduces nearest-neighbor memorization and membership-inference leakage, persistent patient re-identification scores indicate that preventing direct image copying is not sufficient to remove deeper patient-specific anatomical identity, highlighting an important frontier for future privacy-preserving medical image generation.
2607.20692.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個隱私保護框架，用於合成肺部 CT 切片生成，該框架是為了 Image-CLEFmed GANs 2026 挑戰而開發的。<lb/>這種方法結合了最佳傳輸條件流匹配、以隱私為導向的訓練以及一個生成後的「監督者」管道，該管道使用自編碼器嵌入、行列式點過程和斯坦核稀疏過濾生成的候選者，並在學習的幾何潛在空間中進行過濾。<lb/>官方結果顯示出強烈的現實性與隱私之間的權衡，表現最佳的模型達到了 0.549 的隱私保護分數，並且在視覺保真度方面具有競爭力，FID 為 0.3290。<lb/>雖然所提出的幾何過濾顯著減少了最近鄰記憶和成員推斷洩漏，但持續的患者重新識別分數表明，防止直接的圖像複製並不足以消除更深層的患者特定解剖身份，這突顯了未來隱私保護醫學影像生成的重要前沿。
